integrity: A complete constructive proof and self-contained finite verification program are included. No external independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The unrestricted theorem is proved for complete graphs, not arbitrary Hamiltonian host graphs. Historical priority remains uncertain because the complete 1997 graph-path VC-dimension article was not available for inspection. Finite tests are corroboration rather than the proof.
title: Universal edge shattering by Hamiltonian paths of complete graphs
